math_computation.name: math_computation
math_computation.description: Executes deterministic mathematical computations: expression evaluation, linear equation solving, and coordinate distance.
math_computation.usage: Use math_computation when a numerical arithmetic expression (+, -, *, /), linear algebraic equation (solve for variable), or coordinate distance calculation is required. Inputs: expression string or operand parameters (param1, op_str, param2). Produces: deterministic computed numerical result.

parameters_schema.coord_a: First coordinate / position index (scalar or list/tuple)
parameters_schema.coord_b: Second coordinate / position index (scalar or list/tuple)

browser_access.name: browser_access
browser_access.description: Performs browser access for web query search and retrieval.
browser_access.usage: Use browser_access when external real-world factual information, operational command syntax, or current web knowledge is needed that is not stored in AR.I.S cognitive memory. Inputs: query (search phrase or entity topic). Produces: ingested factual statements and textual summaries from verified web sources.

parameters_schema.query: The search query string to look up or navigate in the browser

command_prompt.name: command_prompt
command_prompt.description: Executes command prompt shell commands within a specified working directory.
command_prompt.usage: Use command_prompt when system terminal, command line, or local shell execution is required within a target repository or working directory (e.g. inspecting git status, validating directory paths, running CLI utilities). Inputs: command (shell command string), working_dir (optional target folder path). Produces: command execution output, stdout, stderr, and exit status code.

parameters_schema.command: The terminal command to execute (e.g. 'git status', 'dir', 'git branch')
parameters_schema.working_dir: The target working directory / folder path where the command should execute

sensor_monitor.name: sensor_monitor
sensor_monitor.description: Monitors hardware temperatures and load telemetry.
sensor_monitor.usage: Use sensor_monitor when system CPU or GPU telemetry is requested.

parameters_schema.sensor_id: Identifier of the sensor to query
